title: Hidden paragraphs and body-level range markers take no space and let the neighbours' spacing collapse
source: probe build.py (A4, Arial 10.5): after=120 -> hidden -> before=120 pitches 18.24 like no hidden paragraph; after=120 -> bookmarkEnd -> before=120 = 18.0 (max-collapse); the same docx exported by Word 2026-10-22 (t3_render-hidden-paragraph.pdf) pitches 18.0 across both the hidden paragraph and the bookmarkEnd

cases.note: a text-carrying paragraph whose mark and every run are w:vanish is hidden (zero height, counter advances)
body-level w:bookmarkEnd keeps its position, zero height
margins collapse through the marker: 18.0 pitch
